hunks.baseline: I feel like I’ve gone back to high school.
hunks.sol: It feels like I’ve gone back to high school.

hunks.baseline: “Shall I make sure you can never hear another sound?”
hunks.sol: “Shall I make sure you never hear another sound?”

hunks.baseline: Even so, I needed some kind of life insurance, just in case.
hunks.sol: Even so, I had to take out some life insurance, just in case.

hunks.baseline: *Cheongpung, you have to wake up if I’m going to survive this.*
hunks.sol: *Cheongpung—at least you need to be awake if I’m going to survive this.*

hunks.baseline: “Huh?”
hunks.sol: “Pardon?”

hunks.baseline: I hadn’t made a sound or given away my movement, yet he knew exactly what was happening beneath the table.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t made a sound or given off any sign, yet he knew exactly what was happening beneath the table.

hunks.baseline: “…I’ll stay still.”
hunks.sol: “…I’ll sit still.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re not entirely oblivious, I see. You might live a long time.”
hunks.sol: “You’re not entirely oblivious, I see. That lifeline of yours might turn out to be a long one.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve already heard. He committed more than enough crimes to deserve death. He was a fairly sharp fellow once, but time has ruined a lot of people…”
hunks.sol: “I’ve already heard. He committed more than enough crimes to deserve death. He was a fairly sharp fellow once, but time has cast plenty of people aside…”

hunks.baseline: “That child was like that, too.”
hunks.sol: “That child was no different.”

hunks.baseline: “Give me a drink, too.”
hunks.sol: “Please, give me a drink too.”

hunks.baseline: Right. It wasn’t over yet. The more dangerous the situation, the more carefully I had to think if I wanted to escape it.
hunks.sol: Right. It wasn’t over yet. Especially at a time like this, I had to keep my wits about me if I wanted to get out of this alive.

hunks.baseline: “It was about two months ago. That’s when I met Jopil.”
hunks.sol: “It was a couple of months ago. That’s when I met Jopil.”

hunks.baseline: At the time, I had seen Jopil as nothing more or less than a man who was addicted to killing. He genuinely enjoyed it.
hunks.sol: At the time, the Jopil I saw was nothing more or less than a man obsessed with killing. He genuinely enjoyed it.

hunks.baseline: “It seems it was him after all. So this is what became of him.”
hunks.sol: “So it was him after all. So this is what became of him.”

hunks.baseline: “I liked the fierce look in his eyes, and at the same time, I felt sorry for him. I gave him the name Jangcheon, meaning “Vast Sky.””
hunks.sol: “I liked the fierce look in his eyes, and at the same time, I felt sorry for him. I gave him the name Jangcheon, meaning ‘Vast Sky.’”

hunks.baseline: But the boy’s longing was far more tenacious than he had expected. For an entire year, Jangcheon tried to persuade him every single day without fail. Later, he even went so far as to injure himself or starve himself.
hunks.sol: But the boy’s determination was far more tenacious than he had expected. For an entire year, Jangcheon tried to persuade him every single day without fail. Later, he even resorted to hurting himself or starving himself.

hunks.baseline: “Is it because I’m lacking?”
hunks.sol: “Is it… is it because I’m lacking?”

hunks.baseline: Old age had begun to catch up with him, and it seemed he had grown lonely for human company. The past year had been more than enough time for him to grow attached to the wounded, taciturn boy.
hunks.sol: Old age had begun to catch up with him, and it seemed he had grown lonely for human company. The past year had been more than enough time for him to grow attached to the boy—unusually scarred for his age, and unusually quiet.

hunks.baseline: “Then do it. I’m going to die sooner or later anyway.”
hunks.sol: “Then do it. I’m going to die anyway, aren’t I?”

hunks.baseline: “If I can’t have you as my Master, I’ll kill myself. No—kill me right now. Kill me with the hand that saved me.”
hunks.sol: “If I can’t serve you as my Master, I’ll take my own life. No—kill me right now. Kill me with your own hand, the one that saved me.”

hunks.baseline: Seeing Jangcheon prepared to throw away his own life over it, Jeok Cheongang felt hurt and furious.
hunks.sol: Seeing Jangcheon ready to throw away his own life over it, Jeok Cheongang felt hurt and furious.

hunks.baseline: But at the same time, another thought occurred to him.
hunks.sol: But at the same time, another thought suddenly occurred to him.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang added with a sigh,
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang added, almost like a sigh,

hunks.baseline: He swung his sword like a madman all day long and devoted himself to training his stamina. Even when learning the smallest, most basic techniques, he poured his entire being into them as though he were practicing the greatest martial art under heaven.
hunks.sol: He swung his sword like a madman all day long and devoted himself to training his stamina. Even when learning the smallest, most basic techniques, he poured his entire being into them as though he were practicing the greatest divine art under heaven.

hunks.baseline: Jangcheon had only slightly more talent and physical aptitude than an ordinary person, but Jeok Cheongang gradually improved his constitution by cleansing his sinews and washing his marrow.
hunks.sol: Jangcheon’s talent and physique barely rose above mediocrity, but through Jeok Cheongang’s cleansing the sinews and washing the marrow, he gradually improved his constitution.

hunks.baseline: The old man remained old, but the boy grew into a young man.
hunks.sol: The old man remained an old man, but the boy grew into a young man.

hunks.baseline: Yet compared to his physical growth, the young man’s martial arts failed to progress. Jangcheon grew furious at himself for treading water for years, and at last, something happened.
hunks.sol: Yet compared to his physical growth, the young man’s martial arts failed to progress. Jangcheon grew furious at himself for treading water for years already, and at last, things boiled over.

hunks.baseline: “I understood perfectly. He had spent more than ten years learning nothing but martial arts, barely ever leaving the mountain. And the man who called himself his Master couldn’t offer much help and only focused on his own cultivation. What could I say?”
hunks.sol: “I understood perfectly. He had spent more than ten years learning nothing but martial arts, hardly ever setting foot outside. And the man who called himself his Master couldn’t offer much help and only focused on his own cultivation. What could I say?”

hunks.baseline: He had already emptied several bottles by himself, but his mind was growing clearer by the moment. The same was true of the words spoken by the Azure Sky Sword King when he appeared without warning.
hunks.sol: He had already emptied several bottles by himself, and yet his mind only grew clearer. The same went for the words the Azure Sky Sword King had spoken when he appeared out of the blue.
